Embedding request with encoding_format base64 decodes to a float array embedding

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.embed(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(encoding_format: 'base64', input: 'Test input', model: 'text-embedding-3-small'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].embedding.inspect
```
